build_mctest_dataset: run the build function to download and convert the MCTest dataset into ParlAI fbformat
create_fb_format_convert: create fbformat text files from MCTest TSV and answer files for a given data split
download_mctest_resources: download the MCTest dataset tarball using the RESOURCES DownloadableFile list
review_create_fb_format: review the create_fb_format function that maps A B C D answers to indexed options in fbformat
summarize_build_entrypoint: summarize the build function entry point that orchestrates downloading and converting all six MCTest splits
